title: AfriSpeech-MultiBench: A Verticalized Multidomain Multicountry Benchmark Suite for African Accented English ASR

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the Word Error Rate (WER) of 19 Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) systems on a benchmark of African-accented English against their performance on standard open ASR benchmarks that are predominantly North-American and British English.

Disaggregating and evaluating the Word Error Rate (WER) of ASR models across speakers from distinct African countries and regional accent clusters (e.g., Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Rwanda, Uganda, South Africa, North Africa) to measure geographic performance disparities.
